jobs.title: Social Media & Community Manager
jobs.summary: Manage social media presence, audience engagement and community communication across brands and campaigns. Strong freshers with practical social media skills are welcome to apply.
jobs.descriptionMd:
We are looking for Social Media & Community Managers to manage and grow the day-to-day social presence of Fixen Media, selected brands and client projects.

This role is focused on consistent social media execution, audience communication, community engagement and coordination with content, design and marketing teams.

You may work across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, TikTok, YouTube or other relevant platforms depending on the brand.

We welcome candidates from different experience levels. Strong freshers with practical platform knowledge and good communication skills are encouraged to apply, while more experienced candidates may take greater ownership of content planning, community strategy and multi-brand social operations.

We value judgment, consistency and audience understanding more than simply posting frequently.
jobs.responsibilitiesMd:
- Manage day-to-day social media activity across assigned brands.
- Publish and schedule approved content across relevant platforms.
- Maintain content calendars and coordinate upcoming posts.
- Respond to comments, messages and community interactions appropriately.
- Monitor audience feedback, recurring questions and important conversations.
- Maintain the tone and voice of each brand across social channels.
- Coordinate with writers, designers, video editors and marketing teams.
- Ensure captions, creatives, links and publishing details are accurate before posting.
- Identify content opportunities based on audience behavior and platform trends.
- Monitor basic social media performance and report meaningful observations.
- Escalate complaints, sensitive issues or important inquiries to the appropriate team.
- Support campaigns, launches, events and community activities.
- More experienced candidates may contribute to content planning and broader community strategy.
jobs.requirementsMd:
- Good understanding of major social media platforms.
- Strong written communication and audience-handling ability.
- Ability to maintain a consistent brand tone.
- Good judgment when responding publicly or privately on behalf of a brand.
- Ability to organize content schedules and multiple tasks.
- Attention to detail when publishing content.
- Understanding of basic social media metrics.
- Ability to work collaboratively with creative and marketing teams.
- Awareness of current social media formats and platform behavior.
- Ability to communicate clearly in English and/or Bengali depending on the assigned brand.

Formal professional experience is not mandatory for applicants with strong practical understanding and demonstrable social media work.
jobs.niceToHaveMd:
- Experience managing a brand or organization’s social media accounts.
- Community-management experience.
- Experience with Meta Business Suite or similar publishing tools.
- Basic content-planning experience.
- Basic understanding of paid social media campaigns.
- Experience managing Facebook Groups or online communities.
- Experience with social media reporting.
- Customer-service or audience-support experience.
- Experience with ecommerce, fashion, SaaS or service brands.
- Basic crisis-communication awareness.
benefits: Work across multiple brands and online communities
Exposure to content, campaigns and digital marketing
Opportunity to collaborate with creative and marketing teams
Growth through practical social media ownership
Opportunity to contribute to brand and community development
